title: When launching a RemoteDesktop entry, keyboard focus remains on an invisible command palette.
author: JeremyGNJ

judgment.rationale: The report clearly describes focus remaining on an invisible Command Palette after launching Remote Desktop, and another user sees a similar effect after copying from Time and Date. However, reproduction is inconsistent and no current-version diagnostics identify whether the extension, palette dismissal, or target app owns the focus transition.
evidence: Typed password characters later appear in the reopened hidden palette.
The behavior regressed from 0.99.1 to 0.100.0 for the original reporter.
A Time and Date copy flow may exhibit the same lost focus restoration.
The newest reporter says the behavior is inconsistent.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current stable, extension-specific recording and a fresh report captured immediately after focus is lost.

fix_assessment.rationale: The symptom is credible but intermittent and spans different extension completion behaviors.

issue_context.summary: After a Command Palette extension completes, keyboard focus can remain on the hidden palette instead of moving to Remote Desktop or the previously focused app.
known_information: Remote Desktop launch is the primary reproduction.
A clipboard extension may expose a related focus-restoration problem.
The palette retains keystrokes while invisible.
inferences: Palette dismissal and focus restoration ordering may be involved, but the responsible path is not proven.
issue_context.analysis: A current trace from one deterministic extension path is needed before consolidating the two reports.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: A repeatable current-stable sequence and recording.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Record invocation through target-window focus and state which extension command was used.

information_gaps.information: A diagnostic report immediately after the focus loss.
information_gaps.why_needed: It can correlate palette dismissal and extension activation.

actions.label: Request CmdPal focus-loss trace
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: Please retest on the current stable PowerToys release and capture one focused sequence from Command Palette invocation through the Remote Desktop credential prompt. If focus is lost, submit `/bugreport` before reopening the palette, and include a short recording plus the exact extension command. For the Time and Date case, please report it separately only if the same hidden-palette keystroke behavior occurs.
